title: Frontend requirement evidence proposal
interpretation: verified_local applies to the explicitly observed browser behavior and named source inspection. Remaining acceptance and external qualification are not inferred from UI implementation or synthetic transport tests.

requirements.title: RTL responsive console
requirements.acceptance: Persian layout works at mobile/desktop widths with readable mixed Latin identifiers.
requirements.verified_behavior: Persian RTL and mixed-direction fields render without document overflow at desktop, 390px and 320px widths.
remaining_acceptance: Physical mobile browser and native assistive-technology qualification is tracked separately.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Immediate work overview
requirements.acceptance: Active calls, waiting tasks, today appointments/conflicts, failed notices and service health are prioritized.
requirements.verified_behavior: Overview prioritizes today's appointments, active call controls, open tasks, failed notices and honest configured-service statuses.
remaining_acceptance: Configured readiness is not a claim of live provider health or carrier availability.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Call cards
requirements.acceptance: Cards show masked contact, correct clinic, intent/state/duration and only authorized minimal context.
requirements.verified_behavior: Scoped live-call cards render masked contact, clinic, intent, state and observed duration; no raw transcript/context dump.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Task atomic ownership
requirements.acceptance: Accept/claim prevents accidental competing handlers; reassignment requires permission and audit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Claim uses the authoritative versioned task action; UI merges the returned version before another action and disables concurrent local actions.
remaining_acceptance: Cross-process atomic ownership is established by the backend task-concurrency tests, not inferred from one browser.
external_dependencies: Named staff and measured pickup capacity.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Task lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: Accept, reject/redirect, callback, resolve, reopen and pending status have validated transitions.
requirements.verified_behavior: Task UI supports claim, reassign/redirect, pending, callback, resolve, reject and reopen with reasons and permission-aware controls; callback/resolve/reopen were exercised.
remaining_acceptance: All server transition/concurrency permutations belong to backend regression evidence.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Honest handoff controls
requirements.acceptance: Join/takeover is enabled only for supported media; otherwise staff request/callback status is explicit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Takeover displays callback/requested versus room-ready; actual browser RTC needs explicit microphone action and connected state follows a successful room connection.
remaining_acceptance: Real carrier warm transfer and staff/device acceptance remain external UAT.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Clear appointment statuses
requirements.acceptance: Confirmed, staff review, deposit pending, canceled, expired and failed are visually/textually distinct.
requirements.verified_behavior: Statuses distinguish confirmed, review, deposit pending, canceled, expired and failed; pending payment includes the authoritative expiry.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Staff schedule actions
requirements.acceptance: Authorized booking/move/cancel use same invariant-enforcing API as voice and public channels.
requirements.verified_behavior: Staff booking, move and cancellation use signed offers and version/idempotency protected authoritative APIs; real synthetic workflow passed.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Accessible keyboard UI
requirements.acceptance: Forms have labels, focus, contrast, keyboard navigation, useful errors and screen-reader status.
requirements.verified_behavior: Labeled forms, native dialog focus, keyboard settings tabs, mobile menu focus trap/Escape restoration, live statuses and axe WCAG checks are implemented and exercised.
remaining_acceptance: Automated axe and keyboard checks are not a full screen-reader usability certification.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Browser conversation UI
requirements.acceptance: Start/stop, permission/error, repeat/slow/text alternative and human request have clear feedback.
requirements.verified_behavior: Public consent, start/end, text fallback, correction/repeat/slow controls, real recording and trusted audio, live mute/disconnect and human request are implemented.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Stale/disconnected indication
requirements.acceptance: Live/polled state displays lost connection, stale data and retry without fabricating current availability.
requirements.verified_behavior: Offline notice, polled error/retry, stale overview labeling and media disconnection states avoid claiming fresh availability; reconnect refreshes remote data.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Owner daily digest
requirements.acceptance: Digest counts verified bookings, attendance, cancellations, waitlist fills, open cases and actual usage.
requirements.verified_behavior: Daily digest renders verified bookings, attendance, cancellations, waitlist fills, current open-case backlog and actual usage with definitions.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Building aggregate scope
requirements.acceptance: Supervisors view authorized aggregate counts; patient details remain restricted per clinic membership.
requirements.verified_behavior: Building UI renders only server-scoped aggregate counts and authorized contract allocations, with no patient listing in aggregate views.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Tenant switch context
requirements.acceptance: Switching clinic clears incompatible state and cannot reuse another tenant session/records.
requirements.verified_behavior: Clinic switching replaces the scoped credential and remounts patient/task/settings state; switches and separate partner scope were exercised.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Simple automation controls
requirements.acceptance: Pause and human-primary/after-hours/overflow modes are clear, reversible and audited.
requirements.verified_behavior: All six automation modes have understandable Persian controls and descriptions; production readiness is explicit and no mode selection silently provisions telephony.
remaining_acceptance: Actual mode routing behavior is covered by backend voice/UAT tests.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Patient correction workflow
requirements.acceptance: Caller/staff can correct name, contact, service and date before final explicit confirmation.
requirements.verified_behavior: Staff corrections require reason and explicit confirmation; contact correction resets outreach consent. Caller correction uses trusted conversational turns before a fresh final confirmation.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: PWA/offline behavior
requirements.acceptance: Installability or cache scope is explicit; offline UI never pretends a booking was committed.
requirements.verified_behavior: Application manifest and local fonts are provided; there is no service worker or patient-record offline cache, and offline UI never fabricates committed bookings.
remaining_acceptance: Installability and behavior on actual target mobile OS/browser versions require the device matrix.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Resumable onboarding
requirements.acceptance: Staff can create and configure a clinic without editing YAML; incomplete setup is visibly draft.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner creates a scoped clinic through UI; persisted hours/catalog forms and an incomplete draft checklist allow returning after reload without YAML edits.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Policy rollback
requirements.acceptance: Authorized staff can compare and restore a prior policy without losing intervening audit history.
requirements.verified_behavior: Policy UI shows prior versions and requires an explicit reason/confirmation to restore a reviewed snapshot as a new version.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Automation modes
requirements.acceptance: Human-primary, after-hours, overflow, supervised and paused modes have explicit behavior and staff control.
requirements.verified_behavior: Human-first, after-hours, overflow, supervised, AI-first and paused settings are exposed with their true behavior descriptions.
remaining_acceptance: Production activation and actual call routing are backend/deployment responsibilities.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Clinic policy UAT
requirements.acceptance: Publishing production configuration requires completed clinic-specific synthetic booking/error/transfer checks.
requirements.verified_behavior: Clinic launch review requires five independently identified evidence references, unchecked confirmations, target mode and configuration binding. Browser test verifies incomplete forms do not attest.
remaining_acceptance: No real clinic, carrier, clinical or legal approval was created by the browser tests; backend exact-binding tests provide enforcement evidence.
external_dependencies: Actual clinic reviewer, truthful test execution, carrier/clinical/legal approvals remain separate.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Partner scopes and dashboard
requirements.acceptance: Partner/agency access is explicit per tenant and cannot bypass clinic authority.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner grants/revokes scoped partner access; partner login has a separate aggregate-only dashboard and clinic switch.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: White-label branding
requirements.acceptance: Approved clinic/agency name/colors/voice identity are configurable without changing business invariants.
requirements.verified_behavior: Published identity, brand name/color and bounded pronunciation are configured in owner settings; safe public identity is consumed by the caller page.
remaining_acceptance: Vendor voice selection/rights and representative audible brand quality require separate provider evidence.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Provider/API exports
requirements.acceptance: Permissioned API/export contracts are versioned and support deprecation and audit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner creates bounded scoped API keys, sees a key once, and can revoke it; list responses never redisclose credentials. Permissioned usage CSV export is implemented.
remaining_acceptance: External connector versioning/deprecation and partner API conformance are assessed in backend/provider evidence.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Owner digest channel abstraction
requirements.acceptance: Telegram/Bale/Eitaa or email-style digests can be configured only with platform permission and recipient scope.
requirements.verified_behavior: Digest destination form requires recipient consent reference and explicit enable/automatic-daily choices; queue and delivery status distinguish provider acceptance from delivery. Create/disable was exercised without sending reports.
remaining_acceptance: No platform message was transmitted; platform rights, account provisioning and final delivery remain external gates.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Messaging suppression across channels
requirements.acceptance: WhatsApp/Telegram/SMS/social permissions and opt-outs remain purpose/channel specific.
requirements.verified_behavior: Purpose-specific revocation and channel-specific permission forms preserve explicit consent boundaries; the synthetic opt-out flow preserved appointment records.
remaining_acceptance: Actual multi-platform delivery/suppression is enforced and tested by server adapters and external platform UAT.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: External connector fail-closed
requirements.acceptance: Unconfigured/uncontracted vendor operations return unsupported/pending, never simulated success labelled live.
requirements.verified_behavior: Unconfigured providers are visibly unconfigured; demo/configured status is not labeled live, retries preserve errors, and public mic/RTC is capability-gated.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Browser audio lifecycle
requirements.acceptance: User-initiated microphone permission, connected state, stop, reconnect and cleanup are accurately represented.
requirements.verified_behavior: Real MediaRecorder and LiveKit JS connection, mute, end, track release and typed fallback were observed against local speech/RTC. Caller and staff reconnect states, initial microphone readiness, preserved mute, terminal disconnect, stale-room ownership and delayed-operation cleanup now have separately labeled browser SDK-event-contract coverage.
remaining_acceptance: Full MEDIA-008 acceptance remains partial: the new reconnect test injects API/SDK events and does not establish actual-network reconnection, media continuity, or mobile background/lock recovery. Those require actual transport and device UAT.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Mobile browser matrix
requirements.acceptance: iOS Safari, Android Chrome and in-app browsers pass mic, background/lock/reconnect/accessibility checks.
requirements.verified_behavior: Desktop Chromium with mobile-sized viewports was tested, including microphone lifecycle and local RTC. This does not satisfy the physical mobile browser matrix.
remaining_acceptance: iOS Safari, Android Chrome hardware, in-app browsers, real lock/background/reconnect, Bluetooth and native assistive technology have not been qualified.
external_dependencies: Representative phones/devices, real HTTPS/TURN and approved audio provider
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Pooled building allowance
requirements.acceptance: Included minutes and overages allocate by contract and authorized clinic usage.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner creates an authorized draft building pool and reviews balanced usage allocation; UI explicitly states no charge or settlement is performed.
remaining_acceptance: Signed building/clinic commercial terms and live invoicing approval remain external.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Published deposit policy
requirements.acceptance: Deposits are disabled until amount, currency, expiry, cancellation and refund terms are published.
requirements.verified_behavior: Owner publishes versioned deposit/cancellation/refund terms with explicit confirmation; public safe terms omit merchant identity; staff booking and both waitlist acceptance paths send separately accepted current terms. Waitlist deposit results remain pending payment with a capped expiry.
remaining_acceptance: The browser exercise used synthetic policy publication. Actual merchant/provider and legal validation remain external; backend tests enforce actual-mode acceptance.
external_dependencies: Actual clinic terms and consumer/payment obligations require authorized review.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Atomic acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Two simultaneous acceptances create at most one reservation; patient and offer authorization are checked.
requirements.verified_behavior: Authenticated staff accepts only after explicit patient time confirmation and, for a deposit, separate acceptance of freshly loaded versioned terms. Reload and stale-terms failure clear financial acceptance. Immediate and resumed real demo API acceptance were exercised.
remaining_acceptance: The browser suite verifies the UI contribution and injects one stale-terms response for recovery coverage. Actual stale-policy rejection, offer authorization and concurrent atomic acceptance are established independently by backend tests.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.

requirements.title: Ephemeral media handling
requirements.acceptance: Default media buffers are bounded and discarded; traces do not silently retain full patient audio/transcript.
requirements.verified_behavior: Public consent renders the exact server notice and configured retention days, distinguishing unretained raw audio from encrypted necessary conversation text and request-recovery results. It describes scheduled cleanup, deletion requests and separate necessary appointment records. The same notice is keyboard accessible during conversation; consent sends recording and training disabled.
remaining_acceptance: This verifies truthful disclosure and UI consent behavior. Actual retention/deletion processing, provider policy and legal review are independently validated by server tests and deployment approval.
requirements.scope: UI contribution only; merge server enforcement and external readiness evidence independently.
